assertions.assertion: Sets options.MutualTls.Enabled = true in AddIdentityServer options
Sets options.MutualTls.DomainName = 'mtls' for the mTLS subdomain
assertions.rationale: `options.MutualTls.DomainName = "mtls"` is set for the sub-domain endpoints.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddMutualTlsSecretValidators() on the IdentityServer builder
assertions.rationale: `.AddMutualTlsSecretValidators()` is chained on the IdentityServer builder.

assertions.assertion: Configures the client secret with Type = SecretTypes.X509CertificateThumbprint (or IdentityServerConstants.SecretTypes.X509CertificateThumbprint)
assertions.rationale: The client secret uses Type = SecretTypes.X509CertificateThumbprint with the given thumbprint.

assertions.assertion: Adds certificate authentication scheme (AddCertificate) and references it via MutualTls.ClientCertificateAuthenticationScheme
assertions.rationale: AddCertificate() is registered with the default scheme, but the response never sets MutualTls.ClientCertificateAuthenticationScheme to wire the scheme to mTLS.
